subject: Post-call: MedNova security & deployment options (VPC / air-gapped)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Anita Desai <anita.desai@mednova.com>, security@mednova.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: MedNova security & deployment options (VPC / air-gapped)

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. Short recap and proposed next steps below so we have alignment on requirements and scheduling.

Call recap (high level)
- Scope: Evaluate private deployment options (VPC peering / private link, and an air-gapped on-prem option) for MedNova’s PHI workloads.
- Compliance requirements: HIPAA is mandatory; GDPR applies to certain EU patient datasets; MedNova expects SOC 2 evidence and vendor questionnaire completion.
- Key asks from MedNova: current SOC 2 status, list of data flows, network diagram of the target environment, and the completed vendor security questionnaire.

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) MedNova to share current network diagram and vendor questionnaire (we asked Anita).
2) Redwood to draft: (a) concise VPC/topology options (public-hosted private endpoint, dedicated VPC, and air-gapped on-prem sketch), (b) SOC2 evidence mapping and documentation list, (c) high-level Mutual Action Plan with milestones and dates.
3) Schedule 30–45m technical follow-up to walk the VPC sketches and procurement ask (Weds or Thurs next week).

Questions we flagged for the follow-up
- Do you require a full on-prem install or would a VPC with private link + strict routing meet procurement for PHI?
- Any required key management (HSM) or specific KMS provider?
- Expected timeline for SOC2 Type II or existing evidence windows?

Proposed availability for Redwood: Nov 3rd 10:00–12:00 PT or Nov 4th 09:00–11:00 PT.

Attachments referenced: RW: initial VPC option checklist (I’ll send a sketch once we agree next steps).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

Subject: Re: Post-call: MedNova security & deployment options (VPC / air-gapped)

Hi Vivek — thanks for the summary and for capturing next steps. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: We currently have SOC 2 Type II in process; expected completion window Q1 2029. We do have a set of interim controls evidence we can share now (access logs, change management artifacts).
- HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA is a hard requirement for these workloads. GDPR will apply to patient records originating from our EU clinics — we will provide a short matrix of data residency expectations.
- Procurement asks: they will need a completed security questionnaire and a network diagram showing how Redwood would sit inside our environment. I’ve attached our vendor questionnaire (mednova-security-questionnaire.xlsx) to this reply.

We can do a technical follow-up on Nov 3rd at 10:00 PT — that works for our infra/security leads. I’ll invite Tom (procurement) for the commercial questions.

Attaching: mednova-security-questionnaire.xlsx (small)

Regards,
Anita Desai
Head of IT Security, MedNova Health
anita.desai@mednova.com
